name: Seated Calf Stretch
steps: Sit upright on the floor with your working leg extended straight in front of you and your opposite leg bent comfortably out to the side.
Loop a towel around the ball of your extended foot (or reach forward with your hand if flexible enough) while keeping your knee straight.
Pull gently back on the towel or toes to flex your foot toward your shin until you feel a clear stretch along your calf.
Hold the stretch steadily with slow breaths on one leg, then release gently and switch sides.
tips: Keep your spine tall and working knee straight throughout the hold.
Apply smooth, gentle tension without jerking your toes backward.
